tools.name: sem.search_content
tools.description: Keyword search (not semantic) over public posts, pages, listings, and market insights. Returns the best-matching pages with canonical URL, title, excerpt, and categories. Use it to find existing pages to cite or link to before writing new content. For a "is this topic already covered / what should I

tools.name: sem.list_content
tools.description: Paginated index of all public Semerenko posts, pages, listings, and market insights, newest-modified first. Use to enumerate or audit the full catalogue; pass "search" to narrow. For relevance-ranked matching of a single topic use sem.search_content or sem.find_related.

tools.name: sem.read_public_url
tools.description: Fetch the clean public title, metadata, categories, and full plain-text body (up to ~20k chars) for one published Semerenko Group URL. Use after search/find_related to read a candidate page in full. Returns an error if the URL is not a published public page.

tools.name: sem.find_related
tools.description: Given a topic, draft title, or existing URL, returns the most relevant existing public pages ranked by a 0-1 relevance score, each tagged duplicate_risk (link or update instead of writing new), related (good internal-link target), or weak. Top-level recommendation says whether to write new or consol

tools.name: sem.market_cities
tools.description: Live Semerenko market dataset: estimated median sale price, monthly rent and gross rental yield for 203 Israeli cities (standard-apartment headline, ILS), with page URLs. Optional name filter. Figures are Semerenko Group estimates derived from public transaction records - independent analysis, not o

tools.name: sem.market_city
tools.description: Full market record for one Israeli city: headline sale/rent/yield, per-apartment-size breakdown, neighborhoods with figures and URLs, official-registry amenities (schools, kindergartens, bus stops, clinics by HMO, pharmacies), population. Slug examples: jerusalem, tel-aviv-yafo, beit-shemesh.

tools.name: sem.market_neighborhood
tools.description: Market record for a neighborhood: sale/rent/yield (estimates labelled), per-size breakdown, amenities within 500m. Get slugs from sem.market_city.

tools.name: sem.get_site_inventory
tools.description: Return active plugin/MU plugin summaries, public post type counts, tool inventory, and safe boundaries.

tools.name: sem.get_plugin_inventory
tools.description: Return active plugin and MU plugin headers with public agent-use notes.

tools.name: sem.get_tool_inventory
tools.description: Return the public tools, forms, listings, city guide, chat, and signature entry points agents may route users to.

tools.name: sem.list_city_guides
tools.description: Return Semerenko city/location guide URLs.

tools.name: sem.build_lead_handoff_url
tools.description: Build a visible /form/ URL with intent hints for a human to open. This only assembles a URL; it does not submit anything or contact anyone.

tools.name: sem.get_indexing_status
tools.description: Return public IndexNow, sitemap, llms, robots, and agent discovery state.

tools.name: sem.get_ai_infra_status
tools.description: Return public machine-layer rebuild state, generated file status, and endpoint adoption counters.

tools.name: sem.search_properties
tools.description: Search the published listings on semerenkogroup.com by city, neighbourhood, type, transaction (sale, rent, short_term), rooms, price in ILS, size, floor, mamad, elevator, Shabbat elevator, furnished, pet friendly, parking, hashkafa and keyword. Every result carries listing_url (cite it), inquiry_url

tools.name: sem.get_property
tools.description: Full record of one published listing on semerenkogroup.com by its numeric id, with listing_url and inquiry_url.

tools.name: sem.search_projects
tools.description: Live new-build projects Semerenko Group markets, filtered by city, developer, status or keyword. Each result has the project page (listing_url), the developer and an inquiry_url.

tools.name: sem.list_developers
tools.description: Developers whose new projects are live on semerenkogroup.com, with their profile page and project ids.

tools.name: sem.list_property_cities
tools.description: Every city that has published listings, with counts for sale, rent and short term and the canonical market page URL (or null if none). Use it to pick a valid city value.

tools.name: sem.list_silos
tools.description: List the organized content silos (each is a hub-and-spoke category, for example the buy category silo) with hub URL, spoke count, topic count, and status.

tools.name: sem.get_silo
tools.description: Return the full structure of one silo by category: its hub, sub-hubs, every spoke page (title, url, id, type), topic total, build rules, and status.

tools.name: sem.list_calculators
tools.description: Lists all public Semerenko Group real-estate calculators and tools (mortgage, seller net proceeds, rental yield, investment simulator, transfer costs, compliance helpers, investment score) with their page URLs and whether live AI research is wired.

tools.name: sem.calc_seller_net_proceeds
tools.description: Computes estimated net proceeds for selling an Israeli home: agent fee with 18% VAT, legal costs, estimated mas shevach (25% of the CPI-indexed real gain, with the only-home exemption and its ₪5,008,000 ceiling), mortgage payoff, and other costs.

tools.name: sem.calc_invest_score
tools.description: Scores a budget + goal + Israeli city against the Semerenko market dataset (nadlan.gov.il Israel Tax Authority transactions, 203 cities). Returns the 0-100 fit score, citywide benchmark price/rent/yield, purchase tax estimate, and verdict. Use sem.market_cities for the exact city list.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sem.search_content, sem.list_content, sem.read_public_url, sem.get_site_inventory, sem.get_tool_inventory, sem.list_city_guides, sem.build_lead_handoff_url, sem.list_property_cities, sem.list_silos, sem.get_silo, sem.list_calculators · Private data: sem.market_cities, sem.market_city, sem.market_neighborhood, sem.build_lead_handoff_url, sem.get_ai_infra_status, sem.get_property · Public sink: sem.get_site_inventory, sem.build_lead_handoff_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sem.search_content, sem.list_content, sem.read_public_url, sem.get_site_inventory, sem.get_tool_inventory, sem.list_city_guides, sem.build_lead_handoff_url, sem.list_property_cities, sem.list_silos, sem.get_silo, sem.list_calculators · Private data: sem.market_cities, sem.market_city, sem.market_neighborhood, sem.build_lead_handoff_url, sem.get_ai_infra_status, sem.get_property · Public sink: sem.get_site_inventory, sem.build_lead_handoff_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
